item: {"addr": "0x141229ED0", "comment": "The fixed string \"Virtual Path Follower\": the movement agent factory key of MovementAgentPathFollowerVirtual (92556 moves the actor along its path by speed*dt and sends a movement message: a position write, no animation)."}

{"addr": "0x1407A0490", "comment": "Our name. Registers two agent lists: the standard path agents (1411D34E0, 141224A00) and, separately at +0x110, the Virtual Path Follower (141229ED0). Not on the slide path beyond showing the two sets exist."}
{"addr": "0x14079BEB0", "comment": "Our name. Like 41863: standard agents and the Virtual Path Follower in a second list (+0x50)."}

{"addr": "0x1402D1FE0", "comment": "Our name. Per reference of a cell: actors not disabled/deleted get vfunc 0x91 (Actor::DoMoveToHigh 37288) and a queue entry (140195C90); filters on base form globals 1431DF240/250/258 by mode. Read while looking for what raises an NPC to high process; inferred: a cell attach's functor."}

{"addr": "0x140796460", "comment": "Our name (Bethesda's functor: SwitchToLoadedSetControllerFunctor 36520). Slot 1 of the controller's IMovementMotionDrivenControl (+0x128): picks the loaded (standard) agent set and sets +0x1C8=1, +0x1C9=1."}

{"addr": "0x1407964d0", "comment": "Our name. Slot 2: picks the unloaded agent set (1432423B0, with the Virtual Path Follower) and sets +0x1C8=1, +0x1C9=0. Called only by LoadGame 41716 for a saved state 10/11 (scan of lea rcx,[reg+128h] calls)."}

{"addr": "0x140796760", "comment": "Our name. Slot 3: start animation-driven (the graph's root motion moves the actor) when +0x1C9 (loaded agents). Called by AnimationDrivenHandler 42875 (the graph event) and ToggleMotionDriven."}

{"addr": "0x140796550", "comment": "Our name. Slot 4: start motion-driven. With the loaded set (+0x1C9) picks a standard motion agent (states 3/7/8, 5/4/9); without, the Virtual Path Follower (state 10, or 11) which writes the position along the path with no animation. Called by MotionDrivenHandler 42874 and ToggleMotionDriven."}
{"addr": "0x1407968b0", "comment": "Our name. Slot 6, IsMotionDriven: movement state (+0x1C0) in {1,2,3,7,8,10,11,12,13,14}. Actor::IsMovementAnimationDriven 37486 is its negation."}
{"addr": "0x1407968e0", "comment": "Our name. Slot 7: movement state in {0,4,5,9} (animation-driven states)."}

{"addr": "0x1407972f0", "comment": "Our name. The controller's load from a save/change form: reads its movement state (+0x1C0) and flags +0x1C4..+0x1CA, then re-enters it: states 0-6/12-14 SwitchToLoadedSet first, 10/11 SwitchToUnloadedSet (the Virtual Path Follower), then the state's start function."}

{"addr": "0x140694f4a", "comment": "Movement controller to the loaded agent set (SwitchToLoadedSet 41701), then StartMotionDriven 41703: a high actor never keeps the Virtual Path Follower from here. MoveToLow/MoveToMiddleLow/37624 do the reverse (slot 2, SwitchToUnloadedSet)."}

{"addr": "0x1406a51c0", "comment": "Creates the actor's MovementControllerNPC (Actor+0x150) and picks its agent set by process level: high -> SwitchToLoadedSet 41701, otherwise SwitchToUnloadedSet 41702 (Virtual Path Follower); then StartMotionDriven 41703."}

{"addr": "0x140696060", "comment": "CommonLib vfunc 0xF4 MoveToMiddleHigh (slot order MoveToHigh 0xF1 37621, MovetoLow 0xF2, MovetoMiddleLow 0xF3). Switches the movement controller to the unloaded set (SwitchToUnloadedSet 41702, the Virtual Path Follower) and StartMotionDriven 41703: a middle-high actor is moved by position writes and gets no graph update (only high actors are in the animation job, 41466)."}

{"addr": "0x140688e40", "comment": "Our name. The process level an actor should have: sleeping player or a player's teammate in some states keep the current one; else with 3D (or loading): in a sky cell with 37284 -> 2; its cell attached (TES::IsCellLoaded(cell, true)) -> 0 high; loaded but not attached -> 1 middle-high; else 2 or 3."}

{"addr": "0x140688750", "comment": "Our name. Moves the actor to GetDesiredProcessLevel 37503's level: 0 vfunc 0xF1 MoveToHigh, 1 0xF4 MoveToMiddleHigh, 2 0xF3, 3 0xF2; fades out/disables or stores changes on unload for low levels."}

{"addr": "0x14073c5c0", "comment": "Our name (Precision/activeragdoll hook it as CullActors, vtable slot 1). Per high actor each frame, writes the low nibble of Actor+0x27C: 2 = has a fade node, 4 = faded in (+0x130 >= 1e-5), 1 = culling tested; a failed frustum/occlusion test (141514CE0) clears 2 and sets the 3D's flag 0x100000. So 7 = drawn, 5 = faded in but culled, 2 = not faded in (not tested). Actor::ModifyAnimationUpdateData 38054 reads the 3D flag: a culled actor's graph is not posed (its bones keep the last pose while it moves)."}

{"addr": "0x1406b6300", "comment": "From 1.6.1170 (instruction offsets require review): Fills BSAnimationUpdateData for the actor's graph update: +0x2C visible (3D not culled, or seen within N frames), +0x2A force (already set, boolFlags kForceOneAnimgraphUpdate 0x20000 (cleared here) or kForceAnimGraphUpdate 0x20000000, or a keyword/state). Off-screen actors without force get throttled graph updates. SkyrimCoop sets kForceAnimGraphUpdate on copies (AnimationSystem). 1.7.104: 'visible' is the 3D's flag 0x100000 clear, the flag HighActorCuller::CullActor 40335 sets on a failed culling test (measured 2026-11-05: an NPC in cull state 5 moves with its foot bones still)."}

{"addr": "0x1406b423f", "comment": "kWasInFrustum (Actor+0xE8 bit 21) is written only here: set, then cleared unless the cull nibble (+0x27C & 7) is 7. ProcessTracking is gated (Actor::UpdateAnimation 37361), so for an actor it skips the bit is stale; the nibble is the current frame's truth."}

{"addr": "0x140707C70", "comment": "Not on the slide path: a package/AI routine that skips actors whose cull nibble is 7 (drawn). Read while listing readers of Actor+0x27C."}
